title: Lightly Steamed Norwegian Potatoes Wrap
description: A deliciously herby and satisfying snack combining lightly steamed Norwegian potatoes with a flavorful sauté and wrapped in a warm corn husk.
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan with water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Steam the sliced potatoes for 5 minutes or until slightly tender.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the thinly sliced onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the steamed potatoes, chopped parsley, dried dill weed, salt, and pepper to the skillet.
Toss the potato mixture to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Warm the corn husks by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spoon the potato mixture onto the center of each warmed corn husk.
Drizzle the melted butter over the potato mixture.
Fold the bottom edge of the corn husk up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll into a neat package.
